apps.localizedDescription: iphone-use 0.17.19 的 XCTest Runner，调整包结构以兼容 SideStore 0.7 的扩展处理。此包由 SideStore 签名、安装并续签，需要开发者模式及 Mac/Xcode 通过配套的预安装启动配置运行。手机安装、启动和无线控制仍待实测；这不是独立运行的 iPhone 应用，也不是官方发行包。

versions.localizedDescription:
Experimental SideStore compatibility package of iphone-use 0.17.19 (upstream commit 47cf89852a1de8f2a6670ef4ae811708621825f4).

Build 3 relocates the XCTest bundle to Frameworks/iPhoneUse.xctest, avoiding the inconsistent PlugIns enumeration in SideStore 0.7.0-20260911.328+6032424a. The runner implementation is unchanged. Personal provisioning profiles and certificate signatures are removed. The upstream PolyForm Shield license and required notice are included.

Local archive CRC, actual IPA metadata, nested XCTest presence, deep code-seal verification, and generator checks passed. Real-device installation, launch and wireless use are pending. This is an experimental packaging candidate, not an official upstream release.

SideStore re-signs and manages the app; Mac/Xcode must launch the installed app using UseDestinationArtifacts and the relocated test path. Standard upstream setup installs a separate Xcode-signed runner, so the preinstalled launch integration is required.
